correctness.rationale: Exact Szegő kernel substitution gives the radial Möbius circle. The strict AM–GM inequality between 1,r²,...,\(r^{2m-2}\) shows every radial disk fits in a convex interpolation disk with the same left endpoint. The limiting circle yields the reverse convex inclusion. Tangent geometry and a circular segment yield exact support, contact points, area, and perimeter. Strictness and relative interiority yield the exact attained boundary subset. All quantifiers hold for integers \(m\ge2\) and \(0<r<1\); endpoints handled separately; checked diagnostic script is not used as universal proof.

value.rationale: An exact closed convex hull for all nonlinear monomial Hardy composition isometries resolves a natural shape question in the recent Berezin-range program, beyond the previously known circle-by-circle parametrization. The universal envelope support and tangent transition, exact area/perimeter, and boundary nonattainment are complete geometric invariants for the full monomial family and are useful as benchmarks for nonlinear composition Berezin geometry, not arbitrary parameters.
